Terms & privacy.

Using this site

The information on this website describes Wayline’s services and projects. It is provided for general information and does not create a contract or technical specification for a particular site. Any project scope, programme or commercial terms are agreed separately.

Enquiries

When you email Wayline, we use the details you provide to respond to your enquiry and discuss a potential project. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information in an initial enquiry.

Site performance

Project energy and availability figures reflect operational reporting through September 2026. Emissions avoided is an estimate based on measured charging energy and the method described on our approach page. Actual outcomes vary by site and vehicle use.
